caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with a rectangular top and four slender, tapered legs. The table is colored in light to medium shades of brown, suggesting a wood material. Each of the four legs is evenly spaced at the corners of the tabletop and connected by two sets of horizontal supports: one set near the top, just below the tabletop, and another set situated about halfway down the legs, forming a rectangular frame that adds structural stability. The background is plain and off-white or cream in color, with no additional objects or decorative elements. The perspective is slightly angled, showing two sides of the rectangular tabletop and giving a sense of depth and dimension.
title: Shaker Stand
